adaptations: std::string is the actual admitted std::basic_string using the shared Allocator<char>; Windows wchar_t vector uses that same real allocator. The actual FWrite body is byte-identical after these two type changes.

Both complete original HAVE_OPENSSL category variants are compiled as distinct template instances; the embedding chooses one immutable process feature before publication. No runtime guest feature source is read.

The runtime index replaces the original enum/set_enabled macro store with the same ordered one-way bool store. Release-mode unchecked category access requires a valid index, as the original DCHECK-only getter.
Original category ToLower(#name) traverses the complete array including its terminal NUL. It is retained; no strlen/case-fold literal shortcut is introduced.

Each original static available_category String has native process lifetime. Its actual allocation block retains its original native memory domain past Environment/runtime retirement. These statics are not charged as transient caller storage.

The Permission format_insert callback exposes the existing original String as a borrowed sized span. SizedString converts to an owning String only at the original ToStringHelper::Convert copy, after SPrintF's ret local, avoiding an extra input copy.
Only the real Permission literals Inserting %s and %s%s with string, string-view or C-string operands are selected. General numeric/Boolean/pathlike formatting is not exposed or qualified.

Existing CHECK expressions use the actual direct native assertion owner. Valid selected literals do not exercise malformed-format assertion diagnostics; full template pretty-function equivalence is not claimed.
Caller-provided aligned local storage and the static process placement buffer create the original inline EnabledDebugList bool state. No extra dynamic allocation is introduced for that list.

parse_text has an explicit embedding String materialization prefix. parse_environment uses the actual retained native SafeGetenv NODE_DEBUG_NATIVE path with a supplied Map and required Trace callbacks; there is no RealEnvStore or guest process.env fallback.
scope_limits: Source-only; no compilation, controls execution, build or runtime qualification.
Process feature selection/Parse is original startup-single-owner state. The singleton must not be destroyed through the local-list operation.
This leaf supplies genuine native Debug behavior only. Environment installation, full Node startup, RealEnvStore, process.env interception, tracing and complete CLI policy remain distinct.
FWrite retains its ignored I/O results and no-flush behavior. Actual Windows console behavior is source-authored and unexecuted.
